LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MinchoBloodline.label: (Raven) Mincho Bloodline
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MinchoBloodline.description:
An icy bloodline branch from the Mincho race. The bearer's cellular structure has fundamentally changed, making the bearer completely immune to cold and allowing the conversion of surplus energy into mint chocolate.

Effects:
- Minimum comfortable temperature drops to -500C
- Can produce mint chocolate
